body:
I recently visited Bread for the World offices in DC – they’re one of the supporters of our Everything Must Change tour. Before I left, they asked me to sign some books and Brian Duss snapped this photo.

The creative staff at Bread recently put together this excellent video . It says a lot in one minute!
